name: Park Hyatt Zanzibar

address.street: Shangani Street Stone Town Zanzibar TZ

insider_take: A stunning waterfront sanctuary where Swahili heritage meets contemporary luxury in the heart of UNESCO World Heritage Stone Town.
whats_special: This architectural masterpiece occupies a prime seafront location along Shangani Street, blending seamlessly with Stone Town's historic charm. The hotel features stunning ocean views, traditional Zanzibari design elements, and direct access to the Indian Ocean. As part of Stone Town's UNESCO World Heritage site, you're literally staying within living history dating back over 1,000 years.
pro_tip: Book a room facing the ocean for breathtaking sunset views over the Indian Ocean, and time your arrival during dhow sailing season (November-March) to witness traditional sailing boats gliding past your window.
dont_miss: The famous Forodhani Gardens night market just steps away, where local vendors serve fresh seafood and Zanzibari specialties. Explore the maze-like streets of Stone Town to discover Freddie Mercury's birthplace, the historic House of Wonders, and the aromatic spice markets that gave Zanzibar its nickname as the "Spice Island."
pros: Prime waterfront location in historic Stone Town UNESCO World Heritage site
Elegant contemporary design with authentic Zanzibari architectural elements
Exceptional dining experiences with Indian Ocean views and local spice influences
World-class spa and wellness facilities with traditional treatments
cons: Limited beach access due to Stone Town location
